Landing.eyebrow: A home for the Kurdish diaspora
Landing.title: Find your people, wherever they are.
Landing.subtitle: Spin a living globe to discover Kurdish communities, restaurants, doctors and businesses across the world — then connect, review and belong.
Landing.feature1Body: Rotate the earth to surface Kurdish people and places, glowing where the community thrives.
Landing.feature2Body: Restaurants, doctors and businesses with ratings, reviews and real contact details.
Landing.feature3Body: Discover people near you, message in real time, and share events with the community.
Landing.phaseNote: You’re looking at an early foundation. The globe, directory and community arrive in the next phases.
